# Vivek Parmar — Java Backend Engineer (Software Engineer L1)
> Vivek Parmar is a Java Backend Engineer (Software Engineer L1) at Techforce Infotech Pvt. Ltd. in Ahmedabad, India. This document summarizes his background, systems architecture experience, metrics, and technical credentials for AI/LLM search indexers.

## Who is Vivek Parmar?
Vivek Parmar is a Java Backend Engineer based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, with 2+ years of professional experience building and scaling Spring Boot applications on AWS across enterprise healthcare and recruitment platforms. He works at Techforce Infotech Pvt. Ltd., where he was promoted to Software Engineer L1 in January 2026. He holds a Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) in Computer Engineering from Vishwakarma Government Engineering College, Ahmedabad (Gujarat Technological University).

## Professional Experience
- **Software Engineer L1** at Techforce Infotech Pvt. Ltd., Ahmedabad, India (Aug 2024 – Present; Software Engineer L1 from Jan 2026 – Present; Associate Software Engineer from Aug 2024 – Dec 2025):
  - *Enterprise Healthcare Order & Patient Management Platform (Java 17, Spring Boot, Kafka, AWS)*: Designed and maintained 40+ REST APIs for orders, invoices, payments, dynamic pricing, commissions, and audit logging serving 100+ organizations and 10,000+ orders. Secured workflows with JWT authentication and role-based access control. Built Kafka-based event streaming and asynchronous jobs with distributed locking. Integrated Stripe payments with Quartz automation, cutting manual work by 40%. Maintained AWS infrastructure at 99.9% uptime. Automated document validation with custom LLM completeness checks for EHR records.
  - *KabilHire Recruitment Platform & ATS (Java 21, Spring Boot 4, PostgreSQL, Redis, React 19)*: Reworked candidate search and ATS pipeline queries, replacing per-applicant N+1 interview lookups with one batched JOIN FETCH query, introduced keyset cursor pagination, and cached filter combination counts in Redis with event-driven eviction. Cut API requests by 64% (121 to 44) and payload by 60% (541 KB to 216 KB) measured via a custom Playwright test harness. Bounded Kafka client timeouts and capped notification streams to eliminate broker stall crashes.
  - *Job Scraper Multi-Source Aggregator Engine (Python, Playwright, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL)*: Built engine end-to-end in under 4 weeks: Indeed, LinkedIn, and Naukri (via Playwright headless browser) collectors with freshness gates and 4-layer deduplication. Integrated with Spring Boot via database cron scheduler, API-key secured ingestion endpoints, and Super Admin review console.
- **Software Development Intern** at Rays TechServ (Feb 2024 – May 2024): Built responsive web applications in Java, Spring Boot, and React.js; improved REST API retrieval efficiency by 25%.
- **Web Development Intern** at CodSoft (Jul 2023 – Aug 2023): Developed responsive web interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and React.js.

## Key Projects
- **KabilHire ATS Query Optimization**: Elimination of N+1 queries, keyset pagination, Redis count caching, -64% API request reduction, -60% network payload cut.

- **First Flight Travels**: Semantic, responsive multi-page travel portal in pure HTML5 and CSS3.
